name: Manicule
long_description:
Manicule does AgentRel. We get companies discovered and used by AI agents. Think DevRel, rebuilt for a world where agents make all the decisions. 

Our software tracks how often AI recommends your product; our team handles the strategy, documentation, technical content, and distribution that help developers and coding agents use it. Customers include Agentmail, Greptile, Reducto, and Mastra.

Naman has been doing fractional DevRel since 13. Shreyans started building at 14 and was Supermemory’s founding engineer. We met in high school and have built multiple startups together since.
